title: King leads the pawn
summary: In the endgame the king walks in front of its pawn.

steps.md: In the endgame the **king becomes a hero**! Walk him in front of your pawn, like a bodyguard.
King in front of the pawn: this wins!

steps.prompt: Step to the side so your pawn can run!
steps.hint: Step diagonally next to the pawn path.

steps.question: Where should your king stand?
steps.explain: In front, to clear the road.

steps.prompt: Make a queen! Your king clears the way.
steps.explain: King and pawn team: new queen!
